Radio presenter: And now to our restaurant
information: The Pizzeria San Marco on Steinstrasse
is celebrating its 5th birthday with a menu for a week
for just five euros. We congratulate! Yes, restaurants come and
go: The Greek restaurant Hermes in Berggasse
closed three months ago and now there is a new one there
Restaurant opened, the Wiener Beisl. The cook comes himself
understandable from Vienna and prepares Austrian dishes,
e.g. E.g. Wiener Schnitzel, Tafelspitz and of course delicious desserts.
sen. And opens next Sunday...

به عنوان مثال به عنوان مثال وینر شنیتسل، تافلسپیتز و البته دسرهای خوشمزه.
